closure_sources.observation: Reported that Mid Coast Medical Center in Trinity was scheduled to close April 25, 2025 after 14 months in operation.
Current district page labels Mid Coast Medical Center Trinity as closed.
Rural-hospital-closure table records Mid Coast Medical Center-Trinity, Trinity TX, closure month April 2025.

interpretation: Closure evidence explains why the current operator pointer has no Trinity file, but it does not by itself establish the effective CMS certification termination date, whether any post-closure service remains under CCN 670331, or whether a final facility-specific MRF was published. No sibling Mid Coast file is assigned to this CCN and no compliance conclusion is inferred.
next_action: Obtain authoritative CMS enrollment/certification termination or successor-operator evidence for CCN 670331 and, if a historical HPT obligation remains in scope, locate a dated Trinity-specific MRF or operator confirmation. Retain unresolved until that scope is established.
